summary: Completed comprehensive testing of DockClock detention tracking application. Backend APIs fully functional with 24/24 tests passing. Frontend loads correctly with auth, dashboard, and public pages (Driver, Evidence) working. Protected routes require authentication as expected.

integration_issues.issue: Clerk sign-in tickets are single-use only. After first use, subsequent navigation attempts redirect to sign-in page. This is expected Clerk behavior but makes automated testing challenging.
integration_issues.note: This is expected behavior, not a bug. Tickets are one-time use for security.

passed_tests: Backend: AUTH - Protected API returns 401 without token
Backend: AUTH - GET /me with valid token returns user and fleet
Backend: Rate con extraction with LLM (load SFB-448812)
Backend: Create load from extracted data
Backend: Text driver (SMS not configured - expected)
Backend: Driver ping arrival via geofence
Backend: Data isolation (new user cannot access other fleet's loads)
Frontend: Sign in with Clerk ticket redirects to dashboard
Frontend: Dashboard displays headline and KPIs
Frontend: Driver page loads (mobile viewport, public)
Frontend: Driver page shows facility, GPS status, map, buttons
Frontend: Evidence page shows all 5 exhibits (A-E)
Frontend: Evidence page shows invoice details, amount, status
Frontend: Evidence page has Pay by card and Download PDF buttons

auth.notes: Clerk authentication working correctly. Protected APIs return 401 without token. Sign-in with ticket works. Tokens are properly validated.

rate_con_extraction.notes: LLM extraction working. Extracted load SFB-448812 with 2 stops, detention terms (2h free, $50/hr, 15min increments, $400 cap).

driver_flow.notes: Driver page loads on mobile viewport. Geofence arrival detection works. Manual tap arrive/depart works. BOL photo upload works. GPS permission prompt shown (expected in automated browser).

billing_and_notices.notes: Billing math correct: 3h40m dwell - 2h free = 100min billable, floored to 90min (15min increments) = $75.00. Notice auto-sent to broker before free time expired.

invoices.notes: Invoice created automatically after departure. Send invoice seals evidence with SHA-256 fingerprint. Evidence page shows verified state. PDF generation works (15KB).

stripe_integration.notes: Checkout session creation works. Automatic tax falls back gracefully (expected in test sandbox without head office address).

sms_integration.notes: Twilio not configured (intentional per requirements). API returns {sent:false, reason:'not_configured'} and provides driver_url for manual sharing.

data_isolation.notes: New user without fleet gets 409 when trying to access another fleet's loads. Proper isolation confirmed.

public_pages.notes: Driver page (/d/{token}) and Evidence page (/e/{token}) are public and load without authentication. All exhibits present on evidence page.
